auth_login_intro: Log in to edit your listing.
auth_login_invite_only: Accounts are created by invitation or when a listing is approved, so to appear in the directory,
auth_login_error_invalid: The email address or password is wrong.
auth_login_error_banned: This account is blocked. Write to us if you think this is a mistake.
auth_login_error_limit: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth_password_hint: At least 12 characters. A few random words with spaces work well. There are no other rules, and you can paste.
auth_password_too_short: The password needs at least {min} characters.
auth_password_too_long: The password can have at most {max} characters.
auth_password_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
auth_password_pwned: This password appears in known data breaches. Choose a different one.
auth_reset_intro: Enter your email address and we send you a link to choose a new password.
auth_reset_sent: If an account exists for this address, a link is on its way. It works for 1 hour.
auth_reset_done: Your password is set. You can log in now.
auth_reset_invalid_token: This link is not valid any more. Ask for a new one.
auth_set_intro: An administrator created an account for you. Choose a password to start.
auth_set_done: Your password is saved. You can log in now.
auth_claim_intro: {entryName} is already listed. Claim it to edit it, choose what is shown and keep it up to date.
auth_claim_email: The account will use this address: {email}
auth_claim_invalid: This claim link is not valid or has expired.
auth_claim_taken: This listing has already been claimed.
auth_claim_failed: Could not claim the listing. Please try again.
auth_claim_next: Now choose a password for your account.
auth_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth_login_error_google: This Google account has no account here. Accounts are created by invitation.
auth_claim_used_hint: Already claimed it? Log in, or reset your password if you did not finish choosing one.
auth_claim_remove_intro: You are about to remove the listing {entryName} from the directory.
auth_claim_remove_effect: The listing disappears from the site at once and we will not write to this address again. An administrator can still restore it if you ask.
auth_claim_remove_done: Done. The listing is removed and we will not write to you again.
auth_claim_remove_invalid: This link is not valid or has expired. If you still want the listing removed, write to us and we will do it.
